# Progistics Distribution

Progistics Distribution is a Truck Transportation company. Progistics Distribution provides nationwide logistics and final mile services to carriers, shippers, and logistics providers. They offer technology, infrastructure, and services to keep the final mile moving. Progistics Distribution employs 120 people (-4.0% YoY, -5 people). Headquartered in Oakland, California, United States.

## About

PROGISTICS DISTRIBUTION offers last-mile delivery solutions for the B2B, B2C and omni-channel markets. Our core competency is delivering the most responsive, cost effective, last-mile delivery solutions in order to meet the customers'​ order. We operate on the principal that maximum efficiency is achieved by using our innovative technology, quality management team, and a wide range of delivery resources to meet customer demands.

Our facilities, customers, service staff, and delivery resources all share the same proprietary technology, and our services are focused on providing our customers with a total collaboration of all service components to deliver results each and every time. Regional coverage with local density makes Progistics Distribution the next generation in the last-mile segment.
